The '''Tomb Raider Collectible Card Game''' is based on the ''Tomb Raider'' series. The [[TCGMix]] playtest offers bot games with starter decks and includes some cards from ''Premier'', ''Slippery When Wet'' and ''Big Guns''.<ref name="catalog" />
